title: Pumpkin Kheer Keto Pudding
description: A low-carb and creamy dessert made with pumpkin puree, sweetened with nutty flavors, and spiced with Indian spices.
instructions: 1. In a medium saucepan, combine pumpkin puree, heavy cream, nutritional yeast, sweetener, cinnamon, and cardamom.
2. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and coats the back of a spoon.
3. Remove from heat and stir in salt.
4. Let the mixture cool to room temperature.
5. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
6. Serve chilled, garnished with chopped nuts or a sprinkle of cinnamon if desired.
